description_en: Queries the storage usage of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的空间使用信息
name: DescribeResourceUsage

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

ArchiveBackupSize.description_en: The storage consumed by archived backups. Unit: bytes
ArchiveBackupSize.description_zh: 归档备份的占用空间，单位：Byte

BackupDataSize.description_en:
The total storage consumed by data backups, excluding archived backups. Unit: bytes.

For SQL Server instances, this value indicates the total size of physical backups and snapshot backups
BackupDataSize.description_zh:
数据备份占用的总空间（不包括归档备份），单位：Byte。

对于SQL Server实例，表示物理备份和快照备份的总大小

BackupEcsSnapshotSize.description_en: The storage consumed by snapshot backups for SQL Server instances. Unit: bytes. A value of 0 indicates no data
BackupEcsSnapshotSize.description_zh: SQL Server实例的快照备份占用空间，单位：Byte。0表示没有数据

BackupLogSize.description_en: The total storage consumed by log backups, excluding archived backups. Unit: bytes
BackupLogSize.description_zh: 日志备份占用的总空间（不包括归档备份），单位：Byte

BackupOssDataSize.description_en:
The size of data files in backup sets stored in OSS. Unit: bytes. A value of 0 indicates no data.

For SQL Server instances, this value indicates the storage consumed by physical backups
BackupOssDataSize.description_zh:
OSS中备份集的数据文件大小，单位：Byte。0表示没有数据。

对于SQL Server实例，表示物理备份占用空间

BackupOssLogSize.description_en: The size of log files in backup sets stored in OSS. Unit: bytes. A value of 0 indicates no data
BackupOssLogSize.description_zh: OSS中备份集的日志文件大小，单位：Byte。0表示没有数据

BackupSize.description_en: The storage consumed by backups (data backups + log backups). Unit: bytes. A value of -1 indicates no data
BackupSize.description_zh: 备份占用空间（数据备份+日志备份），单位：Byte。-1表示没有数据

ColdBackupSize.description_en: The storage consumed by cold backups. Unit: bytes. A value of -1 indicates no data
ColdBackupSize.description_zh: 冷备份的占用空间，单位：Byte。-1表示没有数据

DataSize.description_en: The storage consumed by data files. Unit: bytes. A value of -1 indicates no data
DataSize.description_zh: 数据文件占用空间，单位：Byte。-1表示没有数据

DiskUsed.description_en: The used storage (DataSize + LogSize). Unit: bytes. A value of -1 indicates no data
DiskUsed.description_zh: 已用空间（DataSize+LogSize），单位：Byte。-1表示没有数据

LogSize.description_en: The storage consumed by log files. Unit: bytes. A value of -1 indicates no data
LogSize.description_zh: 日志占用空间，单位：Byte。-1表示没有数据

PaidBackupSize.description_en: The billable storage consumed by backups after the free quota is deducted. Unit: bytes
PaidBackupSize.description_zh: 扣除免费额度后，需要付费的备份占用空间，单位：Byte

SQLSize.description_en: The storage consumed by SQL data. Unit: bytes. A value of -1 indicates no data
SQLSize.description_zh: SQL的占用空间，单位：Byte。-1表示没有数据
